title: Payments API 502 triage
text: For payments-api 502 errors after deployment, review deployment diff and error rate. Verify upstream health. A human incident commander decides whether to roll back.

title: Database connection exhaustion
text: For inventory-db database connections exhausted, inspect pool saturation, active sessions and client retry rate. Escalate to the database on-call before changing pool settings.

title: Network latency investigation
text: For network latency, inspect regional network metrics and service request latency before changing routes.
